source.check: Names read on the page image of the Lurgan Mail (9 May 1936, p. 3); the same six members (Allen, Irwin, Gilpin, Wright, Watson presiding) attend the council's annual meeting (Lurgan Mail, 13 June 1936, p. 3).

note: Triennial election of Moira rural district council (seven divisions, one member each). Nominations were received by Mr. W. J. Corner on Wednesday 6 May 1936: 'There will be no election in the Moira Rural District Council this year, as the sitting members have all been nominated and no other candidate came forward.' No nomination was made for Maralin (Marlin) division, whose sitting member is not named, so that division is not recorded. No party labels are printed. Filed on 4 June 1936, the day fixed for the county council and rural district elections in Co. Down (Belfast News-Letter, 13 April 1936, p. 10); there was no poll. Sitting member, sole nomination; no election. Returned unopposed.
